description: Helps you decide how to grow an account in the next 90 days. You give the account name, plus contacts, products, threats and notes if you have them. You get a strategic account plan: a power map with one row per contact you name, whitespace analysis, competitive questions, an answer for each objection and a 90 day plan. It does not look the account up. Read-only for business data. It needs no sign-in and stores no inputs or outputs. Hosted usage metadata is recorded. Missing required fields or invalid values return an error naming what to supply or correct. Use this instead of deal_strategy_coach when you need an account-wide 90-day growth plan spanning contacts and products.

account_name.description: Company/account name. Format is text. For example, "an approved anonymous manufacturer".

account_notes.description: Any additional context about the account. Format is text. For example, "quarterly review completed with the finance lead".

competitive_threats.description: Known competitors in the account. Format is text. For example, "renewal decision depends on a documented approval process".

current_arr.description: Current ARR with this account (0 for prospects). Format is a JSON number. For example, 12.

current_products.description: Products/services they currently use from you. Format is text. For example, "manual invoice review".

expansion_opportunities.description: Potential expansion areas or whitespace. Format is text. For example, "extend the pilot to a second finance team".

industry.description: Industry vertical. Format is text. For example, "manufacturing".

known_contacts.description: Known contacts and their roles, one per line or separated by semicolons, for example: Head of RevOps (champion); CFO. Each entry becomes one row, so put other notes in account notes. Format is text.

your_sector.description: Optional: your company's own industry (not your customers'). When given, it decides the sector notes; when left out, the tool reads it from your words and stays neutral if they are unclear. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "logistics_tech".

your_solution.description: Your product/service offering. Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".

name: account_plan_builder
title: Account Plan Builder
